feed.title: Notes by Abhishek Kumar
feed.subtitle: Engineering notes: Node tooling, browser automation over CDP, and guardrails for AI coding agents.

entry.title: A regex fast path let an auth bypass through my LLM ship gate
entry.summary: agent-fastpath decides obvious ship-gate cases with regexes before calling a model. One rule approved a diff that removed an auth check because it also said "Tests: 214 passed, 0 failed". What went wrong and the rule I use now.

entry.title: Node's built-in WebSocket drops CDP replies over 4 MB
entry.summary: Chromium's DevTools endpoint compresses WebSocket frames, and Node's built-in WebSocket (undici) drops any compressed message over 4 MB inflated, closing with 1006. Repro, numbers, and the --remote-debugging-pipe fix.
